title: Group enters manhole as New York City sewer mystery endures
excerpt: Authorities on Long Island are investigating what these individuals have been doing in the sewer system.
content:
Modern Mysteries

By T.K. Randall
September 2, 2026


Image: New York City
Credit: Karl Döringer / (PD)

Authorities on Long Island are investigating what these individuals have been doing in the sewer system.

A long-standing mystery in the Big Apple has re-emerged this week in the form of CCTV footage capturing the moment a group of people opened up a manhole cover and descended into the sewers.

We first reported on the enigma back in June when multiple instances of people entering the sewers around the city were being investigated by the New York City Police Department.

This time, witnesses saw a group of five individuals enter a manhole at the intersection of Wantagh Avenue and Jerusalem Avenue before carefully replacing the cover.

When officers arrived on the scene they searched the sewer but found nothing.

So what exactly are these people doing down there ?

One possibility is that they have been searching for valuables that have been dropped or washed down the drains, perhaps with the intention of selling anything they find for cash.

It's also possible that they are using the sewers for drug dealing purposes.

Whatever the case, entering manholes is both illegal and dangerous.

Exactly how long this trend is likely to continue currently remains unclear.

Source: ABC7ny.com
